name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-react-content-rollup
title: Content Rollup
shortDescription: Rolls up recent news from a chosen list, or across sites via a Microsoft Search (KQL) query, with no CAML or Handlebars setup.
longDescription: Content Rollup gathers recent news and content from across your SharePoint sites into one web part. Point it at a list (for example, News) and it renders those items newest first, or leave the list blank to run a tenant-wide Microsoft Search (KQL) query instead. It needs no CAML and no Handlebars templating, and it keeps working on tenants where search is restricted by letting you bind a list instead. Four layout styles (Card, Minimal, Bold, Compact), an adjustable item count, and optional heading, border and background colour.
